text:
miguel: @channel - alert: spikes in 5xx and routing thrash observed for eu region after config push. Customers reporting degraded responses. Investigating now. :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Paging miguel (primary oncall) :pager: — incident severity P1 — call: +1-555-0100

miguel: ack — looking at routing service logs. suspect config schema change rolled an old default for 'preferred_region' -> null, causing fallback fanout.

sam: miguel, seeing the same in dashboards — EU latency up 2.4x, 5xx rate from 0.3% to 8% starting ~00:12 UTC.

miguel: repro logs: `routing: evaluatePolicy(user=acct-42) -> variant=redwood-v2-quant, region=null -> fanout to [eu-west, us-west] -> capacity mismatch -> fallback loop`

leah: any recent PRs? I see schema PR merged earlier that removed deprecated `region_hint` field and updated defaults. Could be default interpretation bug.

sam: PR 8234 merged 00:05 UTC: `schema: remove region_hint legacy` — maybe service reads missing field as empty and treats as wildcard.

miguel: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable routing-override to force eu preference 2) throttle incoming traffic to protect model variants 3) rollback schema change to compat mode if needed.

miguel: applying temporary override now:
```
rwctl routes override set --scope=eu --policy="prefer_primary_region" --reason="incident 3745001234"
```

deploy-bot: override applied by miguel at 00:28 UTC — id=ovr-3745

sam: after override, 5xx rate dropping but still elevated. Latency trending down. Looks like fanout suppressed. :thumbsup: 

miguel: rolling out throttling rule to protect lower-capacity variants:
```
rwctl quota set --target=model:redwood-v2-quant --qps=40 --burst=80 --reason="protect during fallback"
```

deploy-bot: quota updated by miguel — target redwood-v2-quant qps=40

irene: i'm joining — what's customer impact? any paying customers hit SLA?

sam: product alerts show ~14 customers with increased error rates; two enterprise teams reported failed inference for >5 minutes (customers: AtlasSearch, NovaDocs). No data leak.

product-alerts-bot: incident annotation: customers_impacted=["AtlasSearch","NovaDocs","ForgeMail"], error_window=00:12-00:35 UTC, estimated_rps_affected=120.

leah: quick assessment: root cause likely config parser defaulting deprecated field to empty list which triggers policy engine to treat as 'all regions allowed' and then fallback logic broadcasts. Need schema compatibility flag.

miguel: trying temporary compat toggle on routing-service config:
```
rwctl config set routing.service.schema.compatibility_mode=legacy_defaults
```

deploy-bot: config change applied; services reloaded (rolling) — 6/6 pods restarted.

sam: after compat toggle, error rate returned to baseline ~00:36 UTC. Looks like this mitigated the fallback loop.

irene: good. miguel, can you collect exact timeline and customer impact for postmortem? We'll also need a mitigation playbook entry.

miguel: on it. timeline draft: 00:05 schema PR merged, 00:12 increased 5xx in EU, 00:20 alerts, 00:28 routing override, 00:31 throttling, 00:33 compat toggle, 00:36 baseline restored.

leah: follow-ups: 1) revert PR or add explicit default behavior in parser; 2) add parser unit tests for deprecated fields; 3) add runtime guard to avoid broadcast fanout when preferred_region is unset; 4) automate circuit-breaker for routing fanout.

sam: logging request id samples attached to thread for postmortem (pids truncated): `req-9a7c`, `req-b33f`, `req-cf12` — show repeated redirect to us-west after eu failure.

miguel: handoff to irene for on-call monitoring/cleanup. Irene, taking primary for next 2 hours.

irene: ack takeover. I'll monitor for 2 hours and then hand back to miguel. Will open postmortem ticket with root cause 'schema-compatibility defaulting behavior' and link logs + commands.

leah: FYI SRE: adding urgent test case to CI that simulates deprecated field removal and validates routing outputs.

product-alerts-bot: Customer communication suggested: brief note to AtlasSearch and NovaDocs explaining transient degradation, root cause and that no data was exposed. Draft will be prepared for review.

miguel: one more mitigation: add a short-term rule to reject ambiguous routing configs at validation time. Pushing commit to infra repo now.

sam: small snippet for validation patch:
```python
# validate routing config
if 'preferred_region' not in config and 'region_hint' not in raw_payload:
    raise ConfigValidationError('preferred_region missing; parser must set explicit default')
```

leah: nice. After postmortem we'll schedule a follow-up to harden parser and update runbook.

irene: closing incident once postmortem ticket open and customers notified. I'll mark incident resolved in 1 hour if no regressions.

miguel: thanks all. main takeaway: schema changes that drop deprecated fields must include explicit compatibility semantics in parser to avoid implicit wildcard behavior that causes routing fanout.

leah: noted for oncall playbook. :memo:

oncall-bot: Incident 3745001234 — status: mitigated, assigned: irene, severity: P1 -> P2, closed_by: irene (pending postmortem)
